test_title: PYST 228: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Pooja is the only sister of Gulab. Keshav and Sumer are brothers. Gulab is the only nephew of Keshav. Sumer is the father-in-law of Sonu (male). How is Pooja related to Sonu?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

According to given conditions,

1) Keshav and Sumer are brothers. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0b33e7cdf6d66e4f12c99b6923c60d401da8182fff8e3a948913f70f5cda4d0.png] 

2) Sumer is the father-in-law of Sonu (male).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39e99f5906e673ec5cc69cd1e8fb00269beb816fc681bdf05ca1abeb593ee88c.png] 

3) Gulab is the only nephew of Keshav. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9576f7253d9c18dd53c0cc239274405b8a5c83691d4f2e11e36de1878f777bdb.png] 

4) Pooja is the only sister of Gulab. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18f6e8904c4c4ee0b043193002ff09914fdac12e0655942c8ae53c1808acfc55.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree Pooja is the wife of Sonu.

Hence, "Wife" is the correct answer.
